description: This Java class defines a custom OpenMRS datatype named FreeTextDatatype, which serializes and deserializes plain text (String). It extends SerializingCustomDatatype and is annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: FreeTextDatatype
classes.description: A datatype class for handling free-text input, serializing and deserializing String values within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns the input String as-is for serialization.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Returns the input serialized String as-is for deserialization.
